english_text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
english_prayer: Father, bring me to the Beginning who is Christ Himself, where life is pure and reality is present. Lord Jesus, make Your speaking within me louder than every other voice until I truly hear You.
luganda_text: Likyo abadde okora ku ntansi, ekyo twaakika, ekyo twakikira amaaso gaffe, ekyo twakitunkulula...
luganda_prayer: Taata, nkampa okudamu ku Kutangiriro akwe Kristo Ye, agwa okuwa amagezi na busannyalwalwalwa bwennyini.

english_text: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
english_prayer: Open my eyes to see the manifestation of eternal life in Christ Jesus. Help me to understand the deepest reality of Who You are.
luganda_text: Okuba bukadde bwe bwatonyonyeeza, tutegeze ku maso gaffe, tuli muzaaliko, era tukukubaganya okwo okubanga okufa okukakasaano, akakwo kabadde ne Taata...
luganda_prayer: Ggana amaaso gaffe okukikira okukakasaano okw'okufa okukakasaano mu Kristo Yesu. Ntulire okumanya ebigazi eringi eby'obanga bwo.

english_text: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
english_prayer: Draw us into authentic fellowship with You and with one another. Make us partners with You in Your redemptive work.
luganda_text: Ekyo twaakikira era twaakika tukulangira mu, yokwobanga ne mwe mwenna mwe musobole okukola emubwanyo n'ffe...
luganda_prayer: Tukaako mu mirembe gyennyini n'afe mu kumwe. Tufuna okukola emubwanyo erw'amazima ne Yo.
